summary: Master strategic planning for nonprofits and public institutions. Learn OKRs, stakeholder engagement, and implementation roadmaps. Enroll now for measurable imp
lede: Strategic Planning for Nonprofit and Public Institutions helps leaders turn broad mission ambitions into focused priorities, measurable objectives, and actionable implementation plans. You will learn to assess internal and external conditions, involve boards, donors, and communities, allocate resources, and align activity with long-term goals. The course guides you through the full planning cycle, from pre-assessment and stakeholder engagement to OKR development, roadmap design, and performance monitoring. Practical exercises produce an OKR dashboard, stakeholder engagement plan, 12-month roadmap, strategic plan template, and stakeholder checklist, with attention to funding volatility, policy shifts, capacity gaps, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead or support strategic planning in nonprofit and public institutions, ensuring mission alignment, measurable impact, and sustainable funding.
modules: Foundations of Strategic Planning in Nonprofit and Public Sectors
Setting Measurable Goals and Strategic Priorities
Barriers to Implementation and Risk Mitigation
Digital Transformation and AI in Strategic Planning
Strategic Plan Synthesis and Executive Communication
Advanced Adaptive Strategy and Crisis Planning
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of your organization's mission, budget, and key programs. No prior strategic planning certification required. A laptop is recommended for digital template work. Participants should bring their institution's current strategic plan (if any) or a list of key priorities to work on during exercises.
